name: Chrome Reveal
tagline: Your skin peels away to reveal the android underneath.
subject: the person
endFrame: Turn {subject} into a sleek humanoid android: polished chrome and white ceramic panels with fine seams, glowing blue light lines along the neck and cheeks, mechanical joints visible at the jaw and shoulders, eyes glowing softly cyan. Keep the outfit, pose and background unchanged.
motion: A thin glowing seam appears on {subject}'s cheek. The eyes power up with a soft cyan glow as {subject} turns slightly toward the camera. Cinematic slow push-in.
